name: elevatr-backend
description: FastAPI backend — use Python venv with requirements.txt; npm is only a convenience alias.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; else exec python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000; fi'
